notes.title: EODS Edition
notes.content:

After fixing some bugs, and integrating Steam Achievements. I hereby declare,
[b]EODS (End Of Development / Support) [/b]edition of HBD-RPG

notes.title: STEAM Achievements integrated
notes.content:
Steam Achievements are finally here for HBD-RPG!

After a lot of hard work and debugging, excited to announce that Steam Achievements are now available for HBD-RPG. This means that you can now earn badges and rewards for your accomplishments.

In addition to Steam Achievements,
I've also fixed a few minor bugs, including boat duplication in the dungeon, the 2nd Entrance of the dungeon, and player movement in the final cut scene.

So what are you waiting for? Start playing today and start earning Steam Achievements!

Have a great weekend and enjoy your new Steam Achievements!
